scenes.narration: Planet Fitness sells gym memberships. So why is it selling treadmills too?
It ended 2025 with about 20.8 million members in nearly 2,900 clubs.
Total revenue was 1.3 billion dollars. Franchise fees, its own clubs, and equipment each bring in a big piece.
Equipment sales rose 21 percent, because owners buy machines for both old and new clubs.
Members pay monthly. Owners pay for the machines.
